I've sent Dana a reply in your DM. Moss's notes give two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers on the 04:00 shift at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk. It was patched that evening and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was working. The note also says to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
- **#4419**: from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. The note says it went to second-tier support for scanner firmware testing. Because the sheet has no date, I suggested Dana check whether the ticket is still open before adding it to the weekly notes.

I read all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. The other two North notes mention QFL but give no ticket number, and the two Central notes don't mention QFL at all. #general and #help-it-ops, the two channels Moss is in that Dana can also see, have no messages.

I left out ticket #4912, which came up in the knowledge brain search. It's on the account's profile page, not in Moss's notes, and that page isn't in the files Dana can see. I also left out the order-form pricing the search returned, since it wasn't relevant. Nothing here needed approval.
